title: Service health and release
description: What every audited diagnos service answers at GET /healthz: that it is up, which build it runs, and where the signed evidence for that build is. Static sites serve the same bytes at /healthz and /healthz.json. The response never depends on a database, a session or the caller.

commit.description: The source commit the build was made from; null only for development builds outside Git.

deployment.description: The hosting platform's id for this deployment (Workers version tag or id, Pages deployment, Actions run id), for operators. Not verified.

build.description: The signed release this service runs, or null when it runs a build without published evidence.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes served at build.manifest.
